commands.name: focused-eslint
commands.command: eslint src/engine/native-worker.ts src/engine/native-worker-client.ts src/engine/frame-patches.ts tests/unit/native-worker-client.test.ts tests/unit/frame-patches.test.ts

commands.name: focused-prettier
commands.command: prettier --check src/engine/native-worker.ts src/engine/native-worker-client.ts src/engine/frame-patches.ts tests/unit/native-worker-client.test.ts tests/unit/frame-patches.test.ts src/engine/README.md docs/development/native-lsdp.md

commands.name: focused-typescript
commands.command: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --types node,vite/client src/engine/native-worker-client.ts src/engine/frame-patches.ts tests/unit/native-worker-client.test.ts tests/unit/frame-patches.test.ts

commands.name: documentation-check
commands.limitation: Sparse checkout omits paths and evidence referenced by the repository-wide documentation index.
